title: Identity derived homology comparison core
statement: Let C be an abelian category with a chosen derived category and n an integer. For every X in the derived category, the identity exact functor homology comparison equals homology applied to the inverse of the canonical derived identity isomorphism.

proof.text: Unfold the localization constructions and use the identity functor on complexes; the remaining equality follows from functoriality of homology and the fully faithful bounded-below inclusion.

lean.statement: theorem identityDerivedHomologyComparisonCore {C : Type*} [Category C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory C] (n : ℤ) (X : DerivedCategory C) : ((𝟭 C).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso n).hom.app X = (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n).map ((mapDerivedCategoryIdIso C).inv.app X)
